name: bot-relay-mcp Local Agent Coordination
free_limit: MIT-licensed local-first MCP coordination server with durable SQLite agent inboxes, tasks, channels, and optional HTTP/SSE integration; no software subscription or hosted quota.
watch_out: Free software only, not hosted AI inference or compute. Bring your own agent clients, model subscriptions/API usage, and infrastructure. Default local-trust HTTP endpoints should not be exposed on shared/public networks; configure dashboard and HTTP secrets for remote/team use. Some federation features are roadmap-only.
